LanguageTool Offline uses the engine, grammar rules, and dictionaries bundled with this app. Text stays on your device. No account, server, or download is needed.

English (US and UK), Spanish, and Catalan (General, Valencià, and Balear) are supported. Hosted AI and large n-gram models are not included.

The native editor design follows fraej/webui-languagetool. LanguageTool is available under LGPL 2.1 or later; dictionaries and dependencies have their own licenses. Source: https://github.com/fraej/languagetool
